transcript_window.text: Just weeks after losing his mother, two months after this, Sarah Matale, his mother, passed away on April 2nd.
And three weeks after the funeral, Vaca learned that the Hilltoppers were canceling his scholarship.
I was shocked, Vaca told CBS Sports.
Vaca had returned to his home to grieve and planned to rejoin the team for the 2026 season.
He participated in spring practice and off -season workouts before his mother's death.
But Western Kentucky and even Western Kentucky flew him home after the loss.
However, communication broke down during his time away.
The program later classified his departure as a failure to report a disciplinary move that blocked him from using the NCAA aid cancellation exemption to enter the transfer portal.
